title: The Polybius Square Grid
description: 🗝️ Recovered Notebook Page containing a 5x5 Polybius Square grid (Row 1: A B C D E, Row 2: F G H I K, Row 3: L M N O P, Row 4: Q R S T U, Row 5: V W X Y Z).
question: Decode coordinates '44 23 15' (Row-Column):
hints: Each number pair represents (Row, Column) in the 5x5 grid.
Row 2, Col 3 is H; Row 1, Col 5 is E.
solution: Lookup of coordinates (4,4), (2,3), (1,5) produces the word 'THE'.
